purpose: Illustrative imagined scene library, not instrument images or historical evidence

Style: refined contemporary Chinese ink wash and opaque watercolor on warm cream paper, muted indigo mountains and rust-red accents, expressive rhythm, clear readable composition at classroom distance, not cartoon. This is an illustrative imagined scene, not historical documentary.
